title: Packing list and dialogue
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: At the airport; at the seaport; my summer holiday
source: Seeded from arabic/y5 lesson 8 (Pupil PDF worksheet: packing list and dialogue)
intro: Read the text carefully. Annotate it: underline key words and write your ideas in the margin.

arabic.text:
- أَيْنَ جَوَازُ سَفَرِكَ؟
- هُوَ فِي الحَقِيبَةِ.
- وَأَيْنَ التَّذْكِرَةُ؟
- هِيَ مَعِي. هَيَّا إِلَى الطَّائِرَةِ!

questions.q: Answer: أَيْنَ جَوَازُ السَّفَرِ؟ (It is in the bag.)
questions.model: Teacher: جَوَاز is a boy word, so هُوَ (it). Then the place: فِي الحَقِيبَةِ.

questions.q: Packing list on the pupil PDF: label six pictures (passport, ticket, suitcase, plane, airport, prayer mat) and write three 'where is it?' answers.
questions.a: Labels correct; e.g. التَّذْكِرَةُ فِي الحَقِيبَةِ
questions.model: Teacher labels the passport and writes: جَوَازُ السَّفَرِ فِي الحَقِيبَةِ.

questions.q: perform the dialogue with a partner (breakout).

blocks.text: Draw and label each one in Arabic.
